title: Simplify Path
description:
Given an absolute Unix-style path, return its canonical simplified form. Repeated slashes count as one; `.` means the current directory; `..` moves to the parent when possible; other dot sequences are ordinary names.

## Examples

```text
Input: path = "/home/"
Output: "/home"
```

```text
Input: path = "/.../a/../b/c/../d/./"
Output: "/.../b/d"
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= path.length <= 3000`
- `path` is an absolute path containing letters, digits, `.`, `/`, and `_`
